title: How the GATE Application Process Works: Documents to Exam Day
description: The GATE application process, step by step: GOAPS, DigiLocker, live photo capture and fees, then what comes after registration (city allotment, admit card, exam day, results). Registration timing is on the official site.
author: Studyloaf Team

content.body: This is a guide to everything around a GATE 2027 application: what you need before you start, what happens during registration, and the steps that follow, up to exam day and results. It isn't a reminder to apply. Registration dates have been revised more than once and two official pages currently disagree on the late closing date, so the timing lives on the official Important Dates page, linked here first.

links.label: Registration deadline: check the official GATE 2027 Important Dates page (dates have been revised more than once)

content.heading: Before you start
list: Applications go only through GOAPS, the GATE online application portal, reached from the official GATE 2027 website

DigiLocker is mandatory for all Indian nationals. A verified DigiLocker account is recommended: with an unverified one, GATE may ask for more documents, and you'll have to show originals at the exam venue
Decide your paper, or your two papers from the official list of allowed combinations
Have a way to pay online: UPI, debit or credit card, wallet or internet banking

content.heading: During registration
list: Your live facial details are captured during registration
Fill in the application and pay the fee electronically. Bank charges are extra
Keep your enrollment ID and password safe, and don't delete the DigiLocker account you applied with: the official site asks candidates not to, because later communication refers to it

table.caption: GATE 2027 application fee per paper, one paper (information brochure Table 5 and the official fees page agree)

content.heading: Worked example: the fee
content.body: A female candidate choosing one paper pays ₹1000 if she registers in the regular period, or ₹1500 in the extended period, plus bank charges. A candidate in the all-others category pays ₹2000 or ₹2500. For two papers, the brochure and the official fees page currently show different amounts in the extended period, so check the official fees page before paying for two. Fees aren't refundable except in one specific two-paper case described in the brochure.

content.heading: If you need to correct your application
content.body: GATE runs a rectification window for corrections after registration. The two official pages that mention it give different dates, so use the Important Dates page and the fees page linked below, and act early rather than on the last day either one shows.

table.caption: What happens after you register (official dates as of 7 October 2026)
rows: Check the official site for your exam city
Download it from the official site when released, and check every detail
Sit the session on your admit card. In a multi-session paper you sit only that session
Check your result; qualified candidates download the scorecard

content.heading: On exam day
list: Follow the instructions on your admit card about what to bring, and bring the originals it asks for (essential if your DigiLocker account was unverified)
The paper is a 3-hour computer-based test in English, with only an on-screen virtual calculator
You'll answer 65 questions for 100 marks: MCQs, MSQs and numerical-answer questions

content.heading: After the results
content.body: The GATE 2027 score is valid for three years from the results date. There are no hard copies of the scorecard. After the free download period a scorecard costs ₹500 per paper, and from 1 January 2028 GATE 2027 scorecards won't be issued at all.

content.heading: Common mistakes
list: Planning around a registration date you read somewhere else. Use the official Important Dates page
Deleting or changing the DigiLocker account you applied with
Assuming a two-paper fee from one official page without checking the other
Not checking the admit card details as soon as it's released

content.heading: Sources and last verified date
content.body: Every GATE 2027 fact in this post was checked against the official GATE 2027 website, information brochure and syllabus PDFs from IIT Madras on 7 October 2026. Official dates and rules can change, so confirm anything you plan around on the official site.
